questions.q: Whom did Hosea take as his wife?
What was Hosea's first son named?
What was the meaning behind naming the daughter Lo-Ruhamah?
options: The LORD will no longer have mercy on Israel
Judah will be carried into exile
The land will become fruitful again
The king of Israel will soon die

questions.q: When Judah and Israel are gathered together, what will they appoint for themselves?
Call his name Lo-Ammi, for ____, and I will not be yours.
In the place where it was said, 'You are not my people,' they will be called '____.'
I will save them by the LORD their God, and will not save them by bow, sword, battle, ____.

items: The LORD tells Hosea to take a wife
Another son is born after weaning

questions.q: Hosea's word came in the days of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, king of Israel.
The LORD says the children of Israel will be as many as the stars of the sky.
What does the unfaithful mother say her lovers give her?
options: Bread, water, wool, flax, oil, and drink

questions.q: In that day, what will she call the LORD instead of 'my master'?
How will the LORD block her way so she can't find her lovers?
options: Hedge it with thorns and build a wall

questions.q: What valley will the LORD give her for a door of hope?
I will allure her, and bring her into the wilderness, and ____.
She didn't know that I gave her the grain, the new wine, and the oil, and multiplied silver and gold, ____.
wrong: which they hid in the ground

questions.q: I will betroth you to me in righteousness, in justice, ____, and in compassion.

items: The mother is charged with her prostitution
The LORD will take back his grain and wine
The LORD makes a covenant with the animals
Those not my people are told, 'You are my people'

questions.q: When she cannot find her lovers, she decides to go even farther from her first husband.
The LORD says he will cause her feasts, new moons, and Sabbaths to cease.
What was Hosea told to do again in this chapter?
options: Love a woman who is an adulteress

questions.q: What did Hosea pay for the woman?
options: Fifteen pieces of silver and some barley

questions.q: Besides turning to other gods, what does the chapter say the children of Israel love?
Afterward the children of Israel shall return and seek the LORD their God, and ____.
Israel will live many days without king, prince, sacrifice, or idols.
Hosea tells the woman she may leave him and be with another man.
What does the LORD say is missing in the land?
options: Truth, goodness, and knowledge of God

questions.q: What does the LORD say takes away understanding?
What do the people consult for answers?
options: Their wooden idol, a stick of wood

My people are destroyed ____.

Because of the people's sin, the land will rejoice and all living things will flourish.

Judah will not stumble along with Israel and Ephraim.

Like whom does the chapter say they have broken the covenant?
Where do the priests murder like gangs of robbers?
For I desire mercy, and not sacrifice; and ____ more than burnt offerings.
He will come to us like the rain, like ____ that waters the earth.

wrong: it is a den of thieves

questions.q: The people say, 'Come! Let's return to the LORD; for he has torn us, and he will heal us.'

What does the LORD call Ephraim, who mixes himself among the nations?
What bird is Ephraim compared to?
The adulterers are burning like what?
options: An oven the baker stops stirring

questions.q: What sign of age is on Ephraim without his realizing it?
They call to Egypt. ____.
They haven't cried to me with their heart, but ____.
They return, but not to the Most High. They are like ____.
On the day of their king, the princes made themselves sick with the heat of wine.
The people consider in their hearts that the LORD remembers all their wickedness.
What idol does the LORD tell Samaria to throw out?
What is over the LORD's house because they broke his covenant?
How does the chapter describe Israel going up to Assyria?
options: Like a wild donkey wandering alone
Like a dove seeking a nest

questions.q: How were the many things of God's law regarded?
For they sow the wind, and ____.
They have set up kings, but ____. They have made princes, and I didn't approve.
Israel has forgotten his Maker and built palaces; and Judah has multiplied ____.

Ephraim multiplied altars for sinning.
According to the chapter, where will Ephraim return?
How did the LORD first find Israel?
options: Like a child in a field
Like a spring in the desert

They have deeply corrupted themselves, as in the days of Gibeah.
What is Israel compared to at the start of the chapter?
How do Samaria and her king float away?
options: Like a twig on the water

Who will be Israel's king because they refused to repent?

options: Like a bird and like a dove

questions.q: When Israel was a child, then I loved him, and ____.
questions.answer: called my son out of Egypt
wrong: gave him the land of Canaan

What does Ephraim feed on and chase?
What does the merchant have in his hand?

By a prophet the LORD brought Israel up out of Egypt, and ____.
questions.answer: by a prophet he was preserved
wrong: by a king he was ruled
by the sword he was saved
by the priests he was taught

questions.q: Jacob fled into the country of Aram. Israel ____.

What will the idol makers be like?

options: A lion, a leopard, and a bereaved bear
An eagle, a hawk, and an owl
A wolf, a jackal, and a fox
A bull, a ram, and a goat

questions.q: Where did the LORD know Israel?
options: In the wilderness, a land of great drought

questions.q: What do the people who make idols kiss?
I will redeem them from death! Death, ____? Sheol, where is your destruction?
I have given you a king in my anger, and have ____.
questions.answer: taken him away in my wrath
wrong: made him fall by the sword

questions.q: They were filled, and their heart was exalted. Therefore ____.
The LORD says there is no savior besides him.
A west wind from the sea will dry up Ephraim's spring and fountain.

What does the LORD say he will be like to Israel?
What does the LORD compare himself to, from whom Ephraim's fruit is found?
Israel's beauty will be like which tree?
Take words with you, and return to the LORD. Tell him, '____.'

The LORD says, 'I will love them freely; for my anger is turned away from them.'
